description: Adult chocolate-brown Labrador retriever. Rich warm brown short fur, floppy ears, broad realistic muzzle, strong but lean body, natural straight tapered tail.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: original lifelike dog animation sprite sheet for a native macOS desktop pet.
Render the same adult dog in exactly eight poses in four equal columns and two equal rows, reading left to right. Poses: 1 standing idle, 2 standing idle with eyes closed in a blink, 3 walking with near foreleg forward, 4 walking with opposite stride, 5 running with extended stride, 6 friendly greeting with one forepaw lifted, 7 lying asleep with head on paws, 8 standing holding a small lime-green ball in its mouth.
All poses face RIGHT in a strict side view. Consistent breed, fur markings, body proportions and scale across every cell. Real canine anatomy: connected shoulders and hips, believable muzzle, small natural eyes, four correctly jointed legs and paws, a single attached tail. Use photographic realism with detailed natural fur, soft neutral daylight and smoothly shaded volume. Readable silhouette when reduced to a small 128px sprite. No pixel art, no pixel blocks, no cartoon proportions, no outlines.
Wide landscape sheet, about 2048x1024. Each entire dog stays inside its own grid cell with generous clear gutters and 12% padding. Whole ears, paws and tail visible. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground, no floor shadows, no grids, no labels, no text, no watermarks, no decorations.
Subject: Adult chocolate-brown Labrador retriever. Rich warm brown short fur, floppy ears, broad realistic muzzle, strong but lean body, natural straight tapered tail.
